sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Protect the caged prisoners through three staggered boss spawns — Berg, Zane, then Narella — each with a different way of threatening the cage. Fail condition is the cage going down, not a squad wipe.

sections.heading: Berg (spawns ~6:50)
bullets: His frontal smash can be cancelled by breaking his breakbar — break it if the smash is heading toward the cage.

sections.heading: Zane (spawns ~4:50)
bullets: Teleports to the furthest player on spawn and drops a blinding field where he lands.
Fires 3 cone shots with escalating damage — each one that reaches the cage can deal up to 50% of its max health, so positioning to block line of sight matters.
Weak to bleeding — opening the Warg Cages beforehand makes this easier.

sections.heading: Narella (spawns ~2:47)
bullets: Summons fiery tornadoes that aggro randomly and repeatedly CC + damage whoever they catch.
Fires flak shots (burning AoE) at the furthest player and a flamethrower at the nearest.
Weak to oil kegs — each keg stacks 25 (max 50), but they deal self-damage, so use them carefully.

sections.heading: Common failure points
bullets: The cage going down from an unblocked Berg smash or Zane cone shot.
Missing breakbar interrupts on the Saboteur adds.
Running out of DPS time — a slow squad sees extra Saboteurs spawn near the end.
